sources.note: Avid HD I/O Guide v8.1 (opened for the avid-hd-io spec): DigiLink PRIMARY and EXPANSION ports. The DigiLink Mini plug is modelled with the shape of a mini DisplayPort plug (7.5 x 4.6 mm shell, 9 mm long, one chamfered side): that resemblance is from general knowledge, not from this guide, and every size is an ESTIMATE.
